editor.notes: The scene kit's sandbox (BF, D-38; simple shapes, no input): affine sprite animation (spin, pulse in a 2x box, squash, a matrix set by hand), scanline effects (a wave on BG0's x scroll, per-line blend weights, window 0's edges per line), palette blends (by tag, by bank, a ramp, a fade by tag) and the animation-script player running data/shapes.canim, 180 frames each, in turn.
